content: Asɑfun womu ɡe u Yedutum kuɑ. Ge wee.

content.text: Nɑ Gusunɔ nɔɔɡiru sue.
Nɑ nùn soku, u koo mɑn swɑɑ dɑki.
Nɑ̀ n nuki sɑnkire, nɑ rɑ Gusunɔ kɑsuwɑ.
Wɔ̃kuru nɑ ku rɑ wɛ̃re.
Nɑ rɑ nɛn nɔmɑ yiiyewɑ wɔllɔ nɑ̀ n kɑnɑru mɔ̀.
Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, nɛn bwɛ̃rɑ ku rɑ kpunɛ.
Nɑ̀ n Gusunɔ yɑɑyɑ, nɑ rɑ n weeweenu mɔ̀wɑ.
Nɑ̀ n bwisikɑ, nɛn ɡɔmɑ yɑ rɑ dwiiyewɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u ku rɑ de n dweeyɑ.
Nɑ ku rɑ kpĩ n ɡɑri ɡere nɛn nɔni swɑ̃ɑrun sɔ̃.
Nɑ rɑ yellu yɑɑyewɑ kpɑ nɑ n ɡɑsɔn ɡɑri bwisikumɔ.
Nɑ nɛn womusu yɑɑyɑmɔ wɔ̃kuru,
mɑ nɑ bwisikumɔ nɑ mɔ̀,
Yinni Gusunɔ u koo sun yinɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ?
U ǹ mɑɑ kɑ sun nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛrimɔ?
Win durom mu kpɑwɑ mi sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ?
U ǹ mɑɑ ɡɑri ɡɛɛ mɔ u sun sɔ̃ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ?
U duɑriwɑ u sun durom kuɑ?
U sun win wɔnwɔndu wunɑriwɑ win mɔrun sɔ̃?
Mɑ nɑ nɛn tii sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, wee ye yɑ mɑn dumɔ,
yerɑ Wɔrukoon dɑm kun mɑɑ kɑ sun wɑ̃ɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, kon wunɛn sɔmɑ yɑɑyɑ.
Domi nɑ yɑɑyɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡii ni ɑ kuɑ.
Kon wunɛn sɔmɑ kpuron ɡɑri kpɑrɑ.
Kon sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinun ɡɑri sɑɑri.
Gusunɔ, wunɛn swɛɛ yi dɛɛrewɑ.
Wɑrɑ u kɑ nun kpɑ̃ɑru nɛ.
A sɑ̃ɑwɑ wi u rɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu ko.
A derɑ wunɛn dɑm mu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ bwesenu sɔɔ.
Kɑ wunɛn dɑmɑ ɑ wunɛn tɔmbu yɑkiɑ
be, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yosɛfun sikɑdominu.
Gusunɔ, ye nim mu nun wɑ, mɑ mu diirɑ,
mu ɡbisɑ sere sɔɔwɔ.
Mɑ ɡurɑ nɛmɔ nɡe dɑɑ surundu.
Mɑ ɡuru ɡbɑ̃sukubu nɔɔrɑmɔ.
Mɑ ɡuru mɑɑkinu dɑɑmɔ wɔllun bɑɑmɑ.
Gurɑ yɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ mɑ ɡuru mɑɑkinu nu hɑnduniɑ kpuro yɑm bururɑsiɑ,
mɑ tem mu diirɑ bɛrum sɔ̃.
A sĩɑ nim wɔ̃kun wɔllɔ kɑ mɑɑ mɛn sɔɔwɔ.
Adɑmɑ ɡoo kun wunɛn yirɑ wɑ.
A derɑ Mɔwisi kɑ Aroni bɑ wunɛn tɔmbu kpɑrɑ nɡe yɑ̃ɑ ɡɔ̃ɔ.
